african/amapiano-instrumental.description: Deep, soulful and hypnotic Amapiano: signature bouncing log-drum bass patterns, soft jazzy piano chords, airy pads, shaker-driven percussion and wide reverb space. Slow-building arrangement with long empty bars, gentle melodic hooks and a warm, elegant late-night South-African house feel.
african/amapiano-instrumental.name: Amapiano (instrumental)

african/desert-blues-vocal.description: Trance-like Saharan desert blues: droning electric guitar with hypnotic pentatonic riffs, loping camel-walk groove, hand percussion, calabash and hand claps, and a raw soulful vocal with call-and-response chants. Repetitive, wide open-space atmosphere, minimal chord changes, warm analog tone.
african/desert-blues-vocal.name: Desert blues
african/desert-blues-vocal.lyrics: About long journeys, home and freedom.

african/soukous-instrumental.description: Bright, fast Congolese Soukous: intertwining clean electric guitars playing rapid melodic sebene patterns, driving snare-and-hi-hat groove, busy congas, melodic bass and warm horn accents. Joyful, dancing and virtuosic, building from a relaxed rumba intro into an ecstatic uptempo section.
african/soukous-instrumental.name: Soukous (instrumental)

african/ethio-jazz-instrumental.description: Hypnotic, modal and deeply soulful Ethio-Jazz: 1970s Ethiopian pentatonic scales over loose jazz harmony, breathy tenor saxophone lead, vibraphone, wah-guitar, Wurlitzer and swinging organic drums with a slight shuffle. Winding melodies, rich groove, mysterious timeless atmosphere and warm, slightly lo-fi analog recording.
african/ethio-jazz-instrumental.name: Ethio jazz (instrumental)

african/afrobeat-classic-instrumental.description: Classic 1970s Nigerian Afrobeat in the Fela Kuti tradition: long hypnotic groove built on tight interlocking guitar and clavinet riffs, deep repetitive bass, busy congas and shekere, a punchy tenor-sax and trumpet horn section with call-and-response riffs, and extended organ and sax solos. Raw analog live-band recording, slow-burning build over many bars.
african/afrobeat-classic-instrumental.name: Afrobeat classic (instrumental)

african/highlife-instrumental.description: Bright, joyful West-African Highlife: two intertwined clean electric guitars, warm horn section, melodic bass, light dancing percussion with cowbell and congas. Celebratory swinging grooves, memorable call-and-response horn motifs and a relaxed, sunlit live-band feel.
african/highlife-instrumental.name: Highlife (instrumental)

african/gqom-instrumental.description: Raw, dark South-African Gqom: broken minimal drum patterns, heavy detuned kick, hard tribal toms, thin ominous synth stabs and percussive synth fragments used as rhythm. Stripped-back, repetitive and physically heavy, with abrupt drops and long hypnotic percussion sections.
african/gqom-instrumental.name: Gqom (instrumental)

ambient/dark-ambient-drone.description: Dark ambient drone: deep sub-bass drones, slowly shifting dissonant textures, metallic resonances, distant processed field recordings and granular noise. No beat, no melody in the conventional sense; tension builds through density and slow filter movement. Cold, vast, unsettling and cinematic.
ambient/dark-ambient-drone.name: Dark ambient drone (instrumental)

alternative/uk-garage-vocal.description: Bouncy, stylish UK Garage: shuffled 2-step drums with swung hi-hats and syncopated snare, deep elastic sub bass, chopped and pitched vocal textures, warm organ chords and a catchy soulful vocal hook. Heavy swing, tight low end, infectious groove.
alternative/uk-garage-vocal.name: Uk garage
alternative/uk-garage-vocal.lyrics: Short, repetitive and focused on movement and attraction.

african/afrobeats-vocal.description: Warm, sunny and irresistibly rhythmic modern Afrobeats: syncopated shaker and log-drum percussion, rolling melodic bass, bright brass stabs, clean highlife-style guitar licks and a relaxed, confident vocal hook with soft ad-libs. Laid-back swing behind the beat, spacious modern pop production.
african/afrobeats-vocal.name: Afrobeats
african/afrobeats-vocal.lyrics: Short, repetitive and uplifting, about joy, movement and living in the moment.

alternative/new-wave-vocal.description: Nervous, danceable early-1980s new wave: clean chorused guitar stabs, bright analog synth lines, melodic driving bass, crisp gated drum machine and live drum blend, and a cool, slightly detached vocal. Tight arrangement, catchy hook, angular rhythm and glossy vintage production.
alternative/new-wave-vocal.name: New wave
alternative/new-wave-vocal.lyrics: About modern life, distance and restless nights.

ambient/chillout-pads-strings.description: Chillout, sentimental and atmospheric: warm evolving pads, soft string layers, gentle guitar, subtle piano and a wide stereo image. Very slow harmonic movement, no drums or only the faintest pulse, calm and dreamy with a long gradual swell and quiet resolution.
ambient/chillout-pads-strings.name: Chillout pads strings (instrumental)

ambient/ambient-guitar.description: Deeply emotional, peaceful and spacious ambient: a clean electric guitar plays a simple memorable melody over a gentle groove with soft organic drums. Subtle strings, distant atmospheric textures, very restrained percussion. Slow development, lots of space, natural dynamics. No pad carpets, no cymbals, no bright metallic percussion. Wide stereo image.
ambient/ambient-guitar.name: Ambient guitar (instrumental)

asian/anime-opening-vocal.description: Uplifting, fast anime opening theme: driving rock drums, distorted rhythm guitar, soaring strings, bright synth leads and a heroic singalong chorus. Short punchy intro riff, rapid pre-chorus build, dramatic key change and a big final chorus. Polished J-Rock production.
asian/anime-opening-vocal.name: Anime opening
asian/anime-opening-vocal.lyrics: About new beginnings, courage and chasing a dream.

ambient/ambient-choir-vocalise.description: Weightless ambient with wordless voices: layered airy vocalise and soft humming drifting over warm sustained pads, distant piano notes and deep reverb tails. Slowly unfolding harmonic movement, sacred and consoling, no percussion, endless space.
ambient/ambient-choir-vocalise.name: Ambient choir vocalise
ambient/ambient-choir-vocalise.lyrics: No words: soft wordless 'aah' and 'ooh' carry the melody.

asian/chinese-traditional-instrumental.description: Elegant and evocative Chinese traditional music: erhu lead, guzheng arpeggios, pipa tremolos and dizi bamboo flute over subtle ambient textures and soft frame drum. Pentatonic melodies, delicate ornaments and glissandi, spacious poetic atmosphere alternating between stillness and flowing motion.
asian/chinese-traditional-instrumental.name: Chinese traditional (instrumental)

asian/city-pop-vocal.description: Smooth, glossy 1980s Japanese City Pop: slap-and-fingered funky bass, warm Rhodes and DX7 electric piano, breezy chorused guitar, punchy horn stabs, gated drums and polished layered backing vocals. Sophisticated jazzy chord changes, memorable chorus, chic nighttime feel.
asian/city-pop-vocal.name: City pop
asian/city-pop-vocal.lyrics: About summer nights, city lights and bittersweet memories.

alternative/britpop-vocal.description: Swaggering 1990s Britpop: jangly and slightly overdriven guitars, melodic bass, tight live drums, occasional Hammond organ and string accents, and a nasal charismatic lead vocal with big singalong backing harmonies. Bold anthemic chorus, classic verse-chorus-bridge structure, warm analog production.
alternative/britpop-vocal.name: Britpop
alternative/britpop-vocal.lyrics: About ordinary life, ambition and youthful defiance.

asian/bollywood-vocal.description: Colorful, dramatic Bollywood playback song: lush orchestral strings, driving dhol and tabla rhythms, bright brass, dholak fills, harmonium and a passionate vocal duet with ornamented melismatic phrasing. Sweeping melodies, joyful dance interlude and an emotional cinematic arc.
asian/bollywood-vocal.name: Bollywood

alternative/alternative-rock-vocal.description: Emotional, slightly dark and highly melodic alternative rock: layered textured electric guitars with chorus and delay, driving melodic bass, dynamic live drums and an expressive intimate vocal. Strong recurring guitar motif, restrained verses, explosive memorable chorus, loud-quiet dynamics.
alternative/alternative-rock-vocal.name: Alternative rock
alternative/alternative-rock-vocal.lyrics: About alienation, change and trying to reconnect with someone.

asian/enka-vocal.description: Traditional Japanese Enka ballad: dramatic vibrato-rich vocal with kobushi ornamentation, over shamisen, koto accents, lush strings, soft brushed drums and warm bass. Minor pentatonic melody, slow swelling emotional arc, theatrical and deeply nostalgic.
asian/enka-vocal.name: Enka
asian/enka-vocal.lyrics: About lost love, the sea and longing for home.

blues/delta-blues-vocal.description: Raw acoustic Delta blues: single resonator slide guitar with a driving thumb-bass pattern, foot stomp, occasional harmonica, and a weathered, cracked vocal. Twelve-bar form, loose timing, call-and-response between voice and slide, dusty mono-style recording.
blues/delta-blues-vocal.name: Delta blues
blues/delta-blues-vocal.lyrics: About hard roads, trouble and holding on.

blues/blues-ballad-vocal.description: Aching slow blues ballad: open, clean guitar with reverb, Hammond organ pads, soft brushed drums, upright bass and a heartbroken, restrained vocal that grows into a raw belt. Long held notes, space between phrases, one soulful guitar solo.
blues/blues-ballad-vocal.name: Blues ballad
blues/blues-ballad-vocal.lyrics: About being left alone at the end of the night.

cinematic/corporate-uplifting-instrument.description: Bright, optimistic corporate track: plucked staccato synth and marimba ostinato, clean muted guitar, warm piano chords, claps, soft four-on-the-floor kick and gentle strings. Clear build from minimal intro to a confident full chorus, positive and forward-looking, polished modern advertising sound.
cinematic/corporate-uplifting-instrument.name: Corporate uplifting (instrumental)

asian/mandopop-ballad-vocal.description: Sweeping Mandopop ballad: intimate piano intro, warm strings, soft acoustic guitar, restrained drums entering at the second verse and a large emotional final chorus with layered harmonies. Clean, emotive vocal, memorable singable melody, polished modern production.
asian/mandopop-ballad-vocal.name: Mandopop ballad
asian/mandopop-ballad-vocal.lyrics: About a love that had to end and the memory that stays.

blues/electric-blues-instrumental.description: Slow-burning electric blues: expressive lead guitar with wide vibrato and bends over warm Hammond organ, deep bass and brushed-to-heavy drums. Twelve-bar minor blues, long dynamic build from a whispered opening to a screaming climax and back down. Live-room feel, real amp tone.
blues/electric-blues-instrumental.name: Electric blues (instrumental)

blues/boogie-woogie-instrumental.description: High-energy boogie-woogie piano: relentless rolling left-hand bass figures, fast right-hand blues licks, tremolos and crushed notes, with upright bass and swinging brushed drums. Twelve-bar form, chorus after chorus of escalating variations, joyful barrelhouse party feel, live vintage recording.
blues/boogie-woogie-instrumental.name: Boogie woogie (instrumental)

blues/chicago-blues-vocal.description: Electric Chicago blues shuffle: overdriven tube-amp guitar, wailing amplified harmonica, walking upright-style bass, barrelhouse piano and swinging drums with rim shots. Classic twelve-bar changes, trading solos between harp and guitar, a gritty confident vocal. Smoky bar-room energy.
blues/chicago-blues-vocal.name: Chicago blues
blues/chicago-blues-vocal.lyrics: About a woman who left, whiskey and getting back up.

asian/j-rock-vocal.description: Energetic J-rock: twin distorted guitars with fast melodic riffs, punchy bass, driving drums and a soaring, emotional vocal. Dramatic pre-chorus, an explosive anthemic chorus and a virtuosic guitar solo; bright, high-energy production.
asian/j-rock-vocal.name: J-rock
asian/j-rock-vocal.lyrics: About running toward a dream against all odds, with a promise to a friend.

cinematic/documentary-underscore-instrum.description: Understated documentary underscore: soft repeating piano figure, warm sustained strings, subtle pulsing synth bass and light organic percussion. Neutral and observational, never overwhelming, with a gentle emotional lift in the middle and a calm resolution. Leaves room for narration.
cinematic/documentary-underscore-instrum.name: Documentary underscore (instrumental)

asian/indian-classical-instrumental.description: Meditative Hindustani classical piece: tanpura drone, slow alap on sitar, gradual entry of tabla in a clear rhythmic cycle, soft bansuri flute answering the sitar. Slow melodic unfolding of one raga, microtonal ornaments, gradual acceleration toward an intense final section. Contemplative and spiritual.
asian/indian-classical-instrumental.name: Indian classical (instrumental)

asian/kpop-vocal.description: Polished, punchy K-Pop: tight beat switches, sparkling synth hooks, deep 808 bass, crisp trap-influenced hi-hats, a dynamic rap section, an airy pre-chorus and an explosive singalong chorus with a post-chorus synth hook. Stadium-ready modern production.
asian/kpop-vocal.name: Kpop
asian/kpop-vocal.lyrics: About confidence, attraction and having fun - mostly Korean, with a few English hook lines.

asian/game-jrpg-orchestral.description: Sweeping JRPG orchestral theme: noble main melody carried by strings and French horn, harp and celesta arpeggios, timpani swells, warm synth pads and a heroic brass climax before an intimate solo-piano ending. Cinematic fantasy world-map atmosphere, memorable recurring theme, rich romantic harmony.
asian/game-jrpg-orchestral.name: Game jrpg orchestral (instrumental)

cinematic/orchestral-action-instrumental.description: Driving orchestral action cue: relentless string ostinato, aggressive low brass punches, snare and taiko percussion, hybrid synth pulses and a heroic horn theme cutting through. Constant forward motion, sudden meter and dynamic shifts, brief lyrical breather before a full-force finale.
cinematic/orchestral-action-instrumental.name: Orchestral action (instrumental)

cinematic/epic-trailer-instrumental.description: Modern epic trailer cue in three acts: quiet ominous piano and pulsing sub hits, rising tension with staccato ostinato strings and taiko-style percussion, then a massive final section with full brass, braams, risers and huge impacts. Clear build-drop-build structure, dramatic silence before the last hit. Powerful, dark and heroic.
cinematic/epic-trailer-instrumental.name: Epic trailer (instrumental)

cinematic/emotional-piano-underscore.description: Deeply emotional cinematic underscore: simple felt-piano motif, gradually joined by solo cello, warm string bed and a distant solo flute. Very slow build to a single restrained climax, then a bare piano ending. Intimate, tender and heartbreaking rather than epic. Natural close-mic sound.
cinematic/emotional-piano-underscore.name: Emotional piano underscore (instrumental)

classical/baroque-concerto-instrumental.description: Lively Baroque concerto movement: harpsichord continuo, string orchestra and a virtuosic solo violin. Clear ritornello form with contrasting solo episodes, running sixteenth-note figures, sequences, terraced dynamics and a strong cadential ending. Period-instrument sound, bright and energetic.
classical/baroque-concerto-instrumental.name: Baroque concerto (instrumental)

cinematic/sports-stadium-anthem.description: Big stadium sports anthem: stomping four-on-the-floor kick, huge claps and gang chants, distorted guitar riff, brass stabs, rising synths and a wordless 'hey-oh' crowd hook. Confident, physical and instantly singable, with a short breakdown before a maximal final drop.
cinematic/sports-stadium-anthem.name: Sports stadium anthem
cinematic/sports-stadium-anthem.lyrics: No verses: a wordless 'hey-oh' crowd hook and short shouted chants.

cinematic/fantasy-adventure-orchestral.description: Warm orchestral fantasy adventure: soaring French-horn main theme, dancing woodwinds, harp glissandi, rich strings, light triangle and tambourine, and a broad brass restatement at the end. Storybook wonder, clear memorable melody with two variations, natural concert-hall recording.
cinematic/fantasy-adventure-orchestral.name: Fantasy adventure orchestral (instrumental)

cinematic/horror-suspense-instrumental.description: Horror and suspense score: dissonant string clusters, col legno and sul ponticello textures, detuned music box, low piano clusters, breathing metallic drones and sudden violent stingers. Long unbearable quiet passages, creeping crescendos, an unresolved ending. No groove, no melody, pure dread.
cinematic/horror-suspense-instrumental.name: Horror suspense (instrumental)

classical/cello-and-piano.description: Intensely emotional romantic duo for cello and piano: warm expressive cello melody over a delicate grand piano accompaniment. Slow memorable phrases, intimate musical dialogue, gradual emotional development with rubato and natural dynamics. Tender sadness and quiet beauty, as if remembering someone deeply loved. Modern classical, close natural recording.
classical/cello-and-piano.name: Cello and piano (instrumental)

classical/impressionist-piano-instrument.description: Impressionist solo piano in the spirit of Debussy and Ravel: floating whole-tone and modal harmony, shimmering pedal-blurred arpeggios, gentle rubato and a wandering melody that never quite resolves. Watery, dreamlike and delicate, with soft dynamics and a natural salon-piano tone.
classical/impressionist-piano-instrument.name: Impressionist piano (instrumental)

classical/mystical-neoclassical.description: Mysterious and deeply emotional neoclassical piece: delicate piano, expressive cello, gentle violin, subtle harp and distant atmospheric textures. Haunting recurring motif, unusual but harmonious chord changes, slow evolving development. Ancient and timeless yet modern, intimate and cinematic. Romantic melancholy with wonder and unresolved mystery.
classical/mystical-neoclassical.name: Mystical neoclassical (instrumental)

classical/gregorian-chant-vocal.description: Gregorian chant: unaccompanied male voices in unison, free-flowing modal melody following the rhythm of the Latin text, no fixed meter, no harmony, no instruments. Austere, meditative and ancient, sung in a vast stone abbey with enormous natural reverb.
classical/gregorian-chant-vocal.name: Gregorian chant
classical/gregorian-chant-vocal.lyrics: A Latin prayer or psalm verse, sung syllable by syllable.

classical/minimalism-instrumental.description: Minimalist piece in the Glass and Reich tradition: fast repeating arpeggiated cells on piano and marimba, slowly shifting phase and additive rhythm, layered woodwinds and strings entering one by one. Hypnotic pulse, very gradual harmonic change, bright and mesmerizing.
classical/minimalism-instrumental.name: Minimalism (instrumental)

classical/choral-sacred-vocal.description: Sacred choral work for mixed choir a cappella: rich four- to six-part harmony, suspensions and resolutions, antiphonal exchanges between high and low voices and a luminous final chord. Slow and reverent, recorded in a large stone church with long natural reverb.
classical/choral-sacred-vocal.name: Choral sacred
classical/choral-sacred-vocal.lyrics: A short Latin sacred text - a prayer for peace, its words repeated and drawn out across the voices.

classical/opera-aria-vocal.description: A dramatic opera aria: soaring soprano over full romantic orchestra with lush strings, woodwind countermelodies and swelling brass. Recitative-like opening, sweeping melodic phrases, an intense high climax and a soft trailing close. Deep emotional pathos, authentic bel canto phrasing.
classical/opera-aria-vocal.name: Opera aria

classical/piano-and-strings.description: Sentimental and elegant piece beginning with intimate piano and gradually introducing warm cello, violin and a soft string ensemble. Strong memorable main theme, subtle variations and a long natural emotional arc moving from loneliness toward quiet hope. Rich but never overblown, natural dynamics.
classical/piano-and-strings.name: Piano and strings (instrumental)

classical/cinematic-romance.description: Intimate modern classical love theme: expressive piano, warm strings, solo cello and subtle orchestral texture. One simple unforgettable melody develops through delicate variations into a powerful emotional climax before returning to quiet intimacy. Romantic and bittersweet rather than epic. Natural concert-hall ambience.
classical/cinematic-romance.name: Cinematic romance (instrumental)

classical/string-quartet-instrumental.description: Classical string quartet movement for two violins, viola and cello: elegant main theme stated by the first violin and passed through the instruments, clear counterpoint, a contrasting minor middle section and a graceful recapitulation. Refined dynamics, close chamber recording, no other instruments.
classical/string-quartet-instrumental.name: String quartet (instrumental)

classical/romantic-string-ensemble.description: Deeply emotional string ensemble led by expressive cello and violin with intimate piano accompaniment. Beautiful recurring themes, rich romantic harmonies, gentle crescendos and strong emotional development. Wistful and heartbreaking without becoming overly dramatic. Cinematic but intimate, warm hall reverb.
classical/romantic-string-ensemble.name: Romantic string ensemble (instrumental)

classical/neoclassical-piano.description: Deeply romantic solo piano: an expressive, highly memorable recurring theme with delicate dynamics, emotional pauses, subtle harmonic tension and graceful development through two variations. Modern classical with romantic influences, melancholic but warm and hopeful. Felt-piano intimacy with audible hammers and natural room sound.
classical/neoclassical-piano.name: Neoclassical piano (instrumental)

comedy/german-absurd-novelty.description: Bizarre German novelty song with a strong rhythmic groove, quirky instrumentation (toy keyboard, tuba, banjo, slide whistle) and absurd comedic energy. Playful, slightly stupid, highly memorable, never serious.
comedy/german-absurd-novelty.name: German absurd novelty
comedy/german-absurd-novelty.lyrics: Very short, catchy and deliberately nonsensical, about a random everyday topic: two or three absurd recurring phrases, playful callbacks and unexpected word combinations.

country/bluegrass-instrumental.description: Fast acoustic bluegrass breakdown: driving banjo rolls, chopping mandolin, flatpicked guitar runs, fiddle and slapped upright bass. Traditional head-solos-head form with each instrument taking a virtuosic break, tight ensemble timing, no drums, single-room live recording.
country/bluegrass-instrumental.name: Bluegrass (instrumental)

comedy/english-parody-pop-vocal.description: Straight-faced modern pop production - glossy synths, big drums, huge singalong chorus - used for completely ridiculous subject matter. The music takes itself completely seriously, with an over-dramatic key change in the last chorus.
comedy/english-parody-pop-vocal.name: English parody pop
comedy/english-parody-pop-vocal.lyrics: A trivial everyday annoyance treated as a life-defining tragedy, escalating into absurdity.

comedy/comedy-rap-vocal.description: Deadpan comedy rap over a hard boom-bap beat: dusty drums, gritty bass, simple looped sample. Confident, aggressive delivery; the joke is the contrast between the serious beat and the trivial subject.
comedy/comedy-rap-vocal.name: Comedy rap
comedy/comedy-rap-vocal.lyrics: Elaborate braggadocio about something completely mundane, with increasingly ludicrous punchlines and one repeated chant hook.

classical/symphonic-orchestral-instrumen.description: Late-romantic symphonic movement for full orchestra: broad noble main theme in the strings, answered by horns and woodwinds, a stormy development with timpani and full brass, and a triumphant restatement. Rich orchestration, wide dynamic range, natural concert-hall recording.
classical/symphonic-orchestral-instrumen.name: Symphonic orchestral (instrumental)

country/americana-vocal.description: Warm Americana / roots song: layered acoustic and slide guitars, dobro, organ pads, upright bass, loose brushed drums and a plainspoken vocal with close male-female harmony. Organic, dusty, unpolished production with plenty of space.
country/americana-vocal.name: Americana
country/americana-vocal.lyrics: About leaving a place behind and looking for something better down the road.

country/country-ballad-vocal.description: Tender country ballad: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft pedal steel swells, piano, upright bass and brushed drums, with an intimate, slightly cracked vocal and gentle harmony in the chorus. One memorable refrain, quiet ending.
country/country-ballad-vocal.name: Country ballad
country/country-ballad-vocal.lyrics: Simple, honest storytelling about a hometown, a parent and the years that passed too fast.

country/honky-tonk-vocal.description: Classic honky-tonk: shuffling two-beat drums, walking upright bass, barroom piano, crying pedal steel and twangy lead guitar, with a nasal traditional country vocal. Vintage 1960s production, call-and-response fills between steel and guitar, danceable and unpretentious.
country/honky-tonk-vocal.name: Honky tonk
country/honky-tonk-vocal.lyrics: About heartbreak, cheap beer and a jukebox.

country/modern-country-pop-vocal.description: Bright modern country pop: acoustic strumming, clean electric guitar and slide licks, banjo accents, punchy programmed-plus-live drums, deep bass and a big polished singalong chorus with stacked harmonies. Warm, radio-ready Nashville production.
country/modern-country-pop-vocal.name: Modern country pop
country/modern-country-pop-vocal.lyrics: About small-town summer nights, a pickup truck and falling for someone.

edm/dubstep-instrumental.description: Heavy modern dubstep: half-time drums, enormous growling and wobbling bass, metallic sound-design stabs, sharp snare on the third beat and cinematic atmospheric intro. Tense build with pitch risers, two contrasting drops, filthy but controlled low end.
edm/dubstep-instrumental.name: Dubstep (instrumental)

edm/breakbeat-instrumental.description: Energetic, funky breakbeat: heavy syncopated broken drums, deep rolling bass, sharp filtered synth riffs and constantly evolving rhythmic detail. Strong recurring motif, dramatic transitions, powerful drops and a filtered breakdown. Raw club energy with polished modern production and wide stereo image.
edm/breakbeat-instrumental.name: Breakbeat (instrumental)

country/outlaw-country-vocal.description: Gritty outlaw country: twangy Telecaster, weeping pedal steel, walking bass, brushed shuffle drums and a weathered, world-worn baritone vocal. Open, honest arrangement and live-room warmth.
country/outlaw-country-vocal.name: Outlaw country
country/outlaw-country-vocal.lyrics: Storytelling verses and a plain-spoken chorus about the road, bad decisions and refusing to be tamed.

disco/classic-disco-vocal.description: Euphoric 1970s disco: four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats, octave-jumping bassline, chicken-scratch guitar, lush string section, brass stabs, sparkling piano and a soaring lead vocal with a full backing-vocal chorus. Long string break, handclaps, warm analog tape production.
disco/classic-disco-vocal.name: Classic disco
disco/classic-disco-vocal.lyrics: About dancing all night and losing yourself in the music.

edm/drum-and-bass-instrumental.description: Fast, energetic drum & bass: deep sub bass, rolling two-step breakbeats, crisp snappy drums and a memorable melodic hook. Strong forward motion, atmospheric intro, half-time breakdown, powerful drop and evolving reese bass patterns. Modern, polished and club-ready.
edm/drum-and-bass-instrumental.name: Drum and bass (instrumental)

disco/italo-disco-vocal.description: 1980s Italo Disco: pulsing analog synth bass arpeggio, gated drum machine, bright cheesy synth lead hook, glittering arpeggios and a heavily accented, slightly naive vocal drenched in reverb. Simple repetitive chorus, dramatic minor-key melody, nostalgic and euphoric.
disco/italo-disco-vocal.name: Italo disco
disco/italo-disco-vocal.lyrics: About a night, a girl and neon lights.

edm/dance-anthem-instrumental.description: Irresistibly groovy dance anthem: powerful four-on-the-floor beat, driving bassline, highly recognizable lead melody and riff, big filtered build-ups and a euphoric drop. Clear intro, breakdown, build and drop structure. Wide stereo atmosphere and loud, polished club mastering.
edm/dance-anthem-instrumental.name: Dance anthem (instrumental)

edm/future-bass-vocal.description: Bright, emotional future bass: pitch-bending supersaw chord stacks, chopped and pitched vocal samples, trap-influenced hi-hats and 808s, soft piano intro and a euphoric detuned drop. Sweet, nostalgic and colourful, with a big singable pre-chorus.
edm/future-bass-vocal.name: Future bass
edm/future-bass-vocal.lyrics: Short and dreamy, about missing someone and letting go.

edm/goa-trance-instrumental.description: Classic 1990s Goa trance: layered acid 303 lines, Middle-Eastern-flavoured minor melodies, rolling 16th bass, analog arpeggios and cosmic pads. Long hypnotic build, a huge melodic breakdown around the middle, then an ecstatic layered climax. Psychedelic, spiritual and endlessly evolving.
edm/goa-trance-instrumental.name: Goa trance (instrumental)

edm/liquid-drum-and-bass-sparse-vocals.description: Liquid drum & bass: warm round sub bass, fast flowing breakbeats with soft snares, lush atmospheric synths, Rhodes chords and a beautiful recurring melody. Only airy vocal phrases as texture and hook elements, no full verses. Smooth, emotional and uplifting with strong progression and a wide, polished mix.
edm/liquid-drum-and-bass-sparse-vocals.name: Liquid drum and bass sparse vocals
edm/liquid-drum-and-bass-sparse-vocals.lyrics: A few airy phrases about distance and longing, used as hooks.

edm/big-room-festival-instrumental.description: Massive big-room festival EDM: enormous distorted kick, simple hypnotic lead riff, huge white-noise build with snare roll and synth stab, and a stripped, hard-hitting drop. Anthemic, direct and designed for a main stage. Very loud, wide and punchy master.
edm/big-room-festival-instrumental.name: Big room festival (instrumental)

edm/jungle-instrumental.description: Raw 1990s jungle: chopped and time-stretched amen breaks, deep rumbling sub bass, ragga-style percussion samples used as rhythmic stabs, dubwise delays and reverb throws. Vintage sampler grit, dark rolling energy, long breakdown into a heavy break-and-bass drop.
edm/jungle-instrumental.name: Jungle (instrumental)

edm/future-rave-sparse-vocals.description: Dark, powerful festival future rave: huge distorted bass, relentless driving kick, tense hypnotic synth riff, dramatic build-ups with risers and snare rolls, explosive drop. Only processed vocal phrases as rhythmic hooks and effects, never full verses. Cinematic, energetic and instantly recognizable, mixed loud and wide.
edm/future-rave-sparse-vocals.name: Future rave sparse vocals
edm/future-rave-sparse-vocals.lyrics: A few short hook phrases - a call to the crowd, a chant - never full verses.

edm/hardgroove-techno-instrumental.description: Relentless hardgroove techno: powerful punchy kick, rolling bass, tribal percussion layers, metallic rhythmic loops and short repeating synth motifs. Minimal melody, maximum groove and forward motion. Dense club energy, dry percussive production and gradual layer-by-layer evolution.
edm/hardgroove-techno-instrumental.name: Hardgroove techno (instrumental)

edm/eurodance-vocal.description: 1990s eurodance: pumping four-on-the-floor kick, bouncy synth bass, cheesy bright synth-brass hook, piano stabs, a rapped male verse and a euphoric female sung chorus. Simple catchy melody, big reverb, nostalgic and unashamedly commercial.
edm/eurodance-vocal.name: Eurodance
edm/eurodance-vocal.lyrics: About dancing, freedom and the night.

edm/hardstyle-instrumental.description: Hard, euphoric hardstyle: distorted pitched-down kick with a heavy tail, screeching reverse bass, aggressive lead screeches and a euphoric melodic breakdown with piano and strings. Massive build with a long riser, then a hard-hitting drop. Raw energy, loud and heavily compressed.
edm/hardstyle-instrumental.name: Hardstyle (instrumental)

edm/neurofunk-dnb-instrumental.description: Dark technical neurofunk: metallic morphing reese bass, precise machine-tight drums, glitchy edits, sci-fi textures and razor-sharp transitions. Minimal melody, maximum sound design, aggressive half-time breakdown and a relentless second drop. Clinical, futuristic and heavy.
edm/neurofunk-dnb-instrumental.name: Neurofunk dnb (instrumental)

edm/melodic-techno-instrumental.description: Dark, emotional and driving melodic techno: deep bass, powerful kick, evolving arpeggios, filtered pads and a distinctive recurring synth theme. Strong tension and release, hypnotic progression, spacious breakdown and energetic peaks. Cinematic atmosphere but clearly built for the club.
edm/melodic-techno-instrumental.name: Melodic techno (instrumental)

edm/progressive-trance-instrumental.description: Smooth progressive trance: hypnotic rolling bass, crisp minimal drums, layered plucks and pads, a gradually unfolding melodic theme and long filter automations. Restrained rather than euphoric, with a deep atmospheric breakdown and a warm, driving second half. Wide, clean and hypnotic.
edm/progressive-trance-instrumental.name: Progressive trance (instrumental)

electronic/berlin-school-sequencer.description: Berlin School / kosmische sequencer piece: interlocking 16th-note analog sequences slowly shifting in filter and pattern, Mellotron-style flute and string pads, a slow Moog lead melody and no drums apart from occasional analog percussion. Hypnotic 1970s Tangerine Dream atmosphere, long gradual evolution, deep stereo delay.
electronic/berlin-school-sequencer.name: Berlin school sequencer (instrumental)

edm/psytrance-instrumental.description: Hypnotic, intense psytrance: relentless driving kick and rolling triplet bass, twisting acid lines, swirling psychedelic pads, intricate percussion layers and heavily modulated FX. Long gradual build, atmospheric breakdown with a spoken sample, and a euphoric full-power final section.
edm/psytrance-instrumental.name: Psytrance (instrumental)

edm/uplifting-trance-instrumental.description: Euphoric uplifting trance: rolling offbeat bassline, driving kick, supersaw chords, sparkling arpeggios and a huge emotional lead melody. Long emotional breakdown with piano and pads, an epic build with snare roll and riser, and a soaring climax. Bright, hopeful and stadium-sized.
edm/uplifting-trance-instrumental.name: Uplifting trance (instrumental)

electronic/downtempo-electronica.description: Hypnotic, slightly exotic downtempo electronica: deep organic grooves, warm analog synths, unusual melodic motifs, subtle ethnic percussion and hand drums, plucked strings and a memorable repeating hook. Slowly evolving, immersive and cinematic without becoming ambient. Wide, warm production.
electronic/downtempo-electronica.name: Downtempo electronica (instrumental)

electronic/analog-space-electronic.description: Analog synthesizer space music: slow-evolving pad layers, wide stereo reverb, filtered sawtooth lead with long portamento, gentle arpeggiated sequence, deep sub-bass drone, tape hiss and analog warmth. Dreamy and weightless, cosmic atmosphere. No drums. 1970s European electronic, cinematic and meditative.
electronic/analog-space-electronic.name: Analog space electronic (instrumental)

electronic/trip-hop.description: Dark, sensual trip-hop: slow heavy broken groove, deep bass, dusty sampled drums with vinyl noise, warm electric piano, occasional tremolo guitar and mysterious cinematic textures. Distinctive recurring melodic motif, subtle tension and gradual evolution. Moody and hypnotic rather than aggressive.
electronic/trip-hop.name: Trip hop (instrumental)

electronic/minimal-electronic-german-voc.description: Minimalist 1980s-style electronic music: precise machine rhythms, dry analog synthesizers, deep repetitive bass and distinctive short recurring riffs. Cool, mechanical and hypnotic; vocals are short repeated phrases, spoken-sung, with little reverb and no dramatic singing. German title.
electronic/minimal-electronic-german-voc.name: Minimal electronic german vocals
electronic/minimal-electronic-german-voc.lyrics: About dystopian futures, technology, AI, robots and humans slowly delegating their memories and decisions to machines.

electronic/cinematic-electronica.description: Mysterious, expansive cinematic electronica: warm analog synthesizers, deep electronic pulses, subtle strings and a haunting recurring melodic theme. Slowly building from intimate minimalism to a powerful wide climax, then gently resolving. Hybrid orchestral-electronic textures, film-score mood.
electronic/cinematic-electronica.name: Cinematic electronica (instrumental)

electronic/chiptune-instrumental.description: Upbeat 8-bit chiptune: square, pulse and triangle wave channels plus noise percussion, fast arpeggiated chords, a bouncy memorable melody and a driving bass line. Classic handheld-console sound with strict channel limits, looping A-B-A structure, joyful and nostalgic.
electronic/chiptune-instrumental.name: Chiptune (instrumental)

electronic/idm-experimental-instrumental.description: IDM / experimental electronica: intricate glitched and stuttered drum programming, granular textures, detuned melancholic synth melodies, unstable time-stretching and sudden silences. Complex but emotional, cold and organic at once, with an unresolved ending. No conventional song structure.
electronic/idm-experimental-instrumental.name: Idm experimental (instrumental)

electronic/synth-pop-vocal.description: Bright, catchy synth-pop: analog synth hooks, punchy drum machines, melodic bass, glassy arpeggios and a clean polished vocal with layered harmonies in the chorus. Glossy 1980s character with modern production, strong verse-chorus structure.
electronic/synth-pop-vocal.name: Synth pop
electronic/synth-pop-vocal.lyrics: About neon nights, fleeting romance and chasing a feeling.

electronic/synthwave.description: Nostalgic, cinematic synthwave: warm analog synthesizers, pulsing octave bass, LinnDrum-style vintage drum machine, shimmering arpeggios and a powerful memorable lead melody. Strong recurring motifs, gradual layering and a dreamy neon nighttime atmosphere. Authentic 1980s character with modern wide production.
electronic/synthwave.name: Synthwave (instrumental)

electronic/vaporwave-instrumental.description: Vaporwave: heavily slowed and pitched-down 1980s soft-rock or smooth-jazz sample, drowned in reverb and chorus, with tape wobble, wow-and-flutter, muffled drums and long looping sections. Nostalgic, hazy, slightly melancholic and deliberately lo-fi.
electronic/vaporwave-instrumental.name: Vaporwave (instrumental)

electronic/peak-time-techno-sparse-vocal.description: Dark, driving peak-time techno: massive kick, deep rumbling bass, tense modulating synth sequences and high-impact drops. Only spoken or heavily processed vocal phrases as dramatic rhythmic hooks. Long hypnotic build, industrial textures, dry and powerful club mix for maximum floor energy.
electronic/peak-time-techno-sparse-vocal.name: Peak time techno sparse vocals
electronic/peak-time-techno-sparse-vocal.lyrics: A few spoken commands or dark phrases - 'move', 'the night is ours' - as rhythmic hooks.

electronic/electro-swing-vocal.description: Playful electro swing: sampled 1920s big-band brass and clarinet loops with crackle, over a modern four-on-the-floor beat, walking bass, ukulele-banjo chops and filtered breakdowns. Vintage-sounding crooning vocals with megaphone-style filtering. Fun, dancey and theatrical.
electronic/electro-swing-vocal.name: Electro swing
electronic/electro-swing-vocal.lyrics: About a wild night out in an old speakeasy.

electronic/lofi-hiphop-instrumental.description: Cozy lo-fi hip-hop beat: dusty swung drums with soft snare, warm upright-style bass, jazzy Rhodes and muted piano chords, vinyl crackle, tape saturation and distant rain ambience. Simple looping progression with small variations, no build-ups, perfect for studying and relaxing.
electronic/lofi-hiphop-instrumental.name: Lofi hiphop (instrumental)

electronic/ebm-darkwave-vocal.description: Cold EBM / darkwave: relentless sequenced analog bass, hard gated drum machine, icy detuned pads, metallic percussion and a distorted, half-shouted vocal drenched in delay. Repetitive machine-like structure, minor key, industrial and hypnotic.
electronic/ebm-darkwave-vocal.name: Ebm darkwave

european/balkan-brass-instrumental.description: High-energy Balkan brass band: blaring trumpets in tight harmony, oompah tuba bass, snare and booming tupan drums, odd-meter grooves and virtuosic unison runs. Starts as a slow rubato lament, then accelerates into a frenzied, joyful, unstoppably danceable finale.
european/balkan-brass-instrumental.name: Balkan brass (instrumental)

european/carnival-song-vocal.description: Rhineland carnival song: a swaying schunkel waltz with brass band, accordion, tuba bass, snare and a big singing crowd. Warm, sentimental verses and a rousing chorus that the whole hall sings, clapping on the beat.
european/carnival-song-vocal.name: German carnival song
european/carnival-song-vocal.voice: warm male vocal with a singing crowd
european/carnival-song-vocal.lyrics: About the hometown, its people and carnival: everyone arm in arm, swaying together, a chorus for the whole hall.

european/alpine-volksmusik-instrumental.description: Traditional Alpine Volksmusik: diatonic button accordion and Steirische harmonika lead, tuba oompah bass, brass, zither and clarinet, with a simple cheerful major melody. Ländler lilt, clean acoustic recording, warm and homely. Perfect for a village festival.
european/alpine-volksmusik-instrumental.name: Alpine volksmusik (instrumental)

european/fado-vocal.description: Deeply emotional Portuguese fado: Portuguese guitarra with its shimmering tremolo lines, classical guitar and bass viola, and a dramatic heartbroken vocal full of rubato and sudden dynamic swells. No drums, minor key, aching saudade.
european/fado-vocal.name: Fado
european/fado-vocal.lyrics: About fate, the sea and missing someone.

european/chanson-vocal.description: Elegant and theatrical French chanson: piano, accordion, double bass, brushed drums and a smoky expressive vocal with dramatic rubato phrasing. Waltzing lilt, intimate verses growing into a passionate refrain, warm vintage Parisian recording.
european/chanson-vocal.name: Chanson
european/chanson-vocal.lyrics: About love, loss and the poetry of everyday life.

european/flamenco-instrumental.description: Passionate and virtuosic flamenco: fast rasgueado and picado nylon-string guitar, palmas handclaps, cajón, zapateado footwork and soaring Phrygian melodic lines. Free rubato falseta passages alternating with driving compás sections, dramatic pauses, intense Andalusian spirit.
european/flamenco-instrumental.name: Flamenco (instrumental)

european/italian-pop-vocal.description: Italian pop in the canzone tradition: piano and acoustic guitar, a lush string arrangement, warm bass and soft drums, building to a grand, emotional chorus. Melodic, romantic and elegant, with a passionate final chorus.
european/italian-pop-vocal.name: Italian pop
european/italian-pop-vocal.lyrics: About a love remembered on a summer evening by the sea, with longing and gratitude.

european/party-schlager-vocal.description: German party Schlager for a festival tent or après-ski: pounding four-on-the-floor kick, cheesy synth brass, accordion stabs, a huge 'oh-oh-oh' crowd hook and a call-and-response chorus. Simple, loud and euphoric, with a breakdown for clapping and a final key change.
european/party-schlager-vocal.name: Party Schlager
european/party-schlager-vocal.voice: loud, cheerful male vocal with a shouting crowd
european/party-schlager-vocal.lyrics: A party anthem with a chorus of a few words to shout along: the night, friends and one more round.

european/irish-pub-session-instrumental.description: Lively Irish pub session: fiddle and tin whistle playing a reel in unison, bouncing bodhrán, strummed DADGAD guitar, button accordion and occasional uilleann pipes. Traditional two-tune set with repeats, accelerating energy, hand claps and a raw live-room recording.
european/irish-pub-session-instrumental.name: Irish pub session (instrumental)

european/russian-folk-vocal.description: Russian folk song: balalaika tremolo, bayan accordion, domra and a deep male choir answering a solo lead voice. Starts slow and mournful in a minor key, then accelerates into a wild, stomping dance with handclaps and shouts. Earthy, emotional and theatrical.
european/russian-folk-vocal.name: Russian folk
european/russian-folk-vocal.lyrics: About home, the old village and a love left behind, remembered with longing - then a defiant toast to life.

european/polka-instrumental.description: Fast traditional polka: accordion and clarinet melody, oompah tuba and snare backbeat, trumpet harmonies and a bouncing two-beat groove. Bright major key, clear A-B-C sections with repeats, joyful and irresistibly danceable.
european/polka-instrumental.name: Polka (instrumental)

folk/german-liedermacher-vocal.description: German Liedermacher song: a single fingerpicked acoustic guitar carrying the song, maybe a harmonica between verses, a close, unpolished voice in front. Many verses, a short refrain, the words in the spotlight; intimate, live and without studio gloss.
folk/german-liedermacher-vocal.name: German Liedermacher
folk/german-liedermacher-vocal.lyrics: A wry, poetic story about everyday life that turns into a sharp observation about the times.

folk/celtic-folk-vocal.description: Intimate, mystical Celtic folk: acoustic guitar, Celtic harp, soft fiddle, low whistle and subtle bodhrán. Modal memorable melodies and a gently flowing arrangement that grows with each verse. Poetic and timeless, with a haunting recurring chorus.
folk/celtic-folk-vocal.name: Celtic folk
folk/celtic-folk-vocal.lyrics: About two lovers separated by distance, remembering each other beneath the same moon.

european/klezmer-instrumental.description: Expressive and festive klezmer: wailing clarinet lead with bent notes and krekhts sobs, over accordion, violin, upright bass and driving frame drum. Laughing-and-crying phrases in a freygish mode, a slow doina-style intro then an accelerating wedding-dance finale.
european/klezmer-instrumental.name: Klezmer (instrumental)

folk/appalachian-folk-instrumental.description: Old-time Appalachian music: clawhammer banjo drone, fiddle double stops, flatpicked guitar and gentle upright bass. Modal mountain melody repeating with subtle variations, loose rhythmic lilt, front-porch atmosphere with a single-mic live sound.
folk/appalachian-folk-instrumental.name: Appalachian folk (instrumental)

folk/dark-fairytale-folk-vocal.description: Enchanting and slightly eerie folk: soft close vocals, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, harp, cello, distant flute and restrained hand percussion. Beautiful recurring modal melody with a mysterious fairytale atmosphere. Romantic, poetic and haunting rather than frightening.
folk/dark-fairytale-folk-vocal.name: Dark fairytale folk
folk/dark-fairytale-folk-vocal.lyrics: About entering an ancient forest where memories, dreams and reality slowly become indistinguishable.

folk/folk-punk-vocal.description: Raucous folk punk: furiously strummed acoustic guitar, banjo, accordion, upright bass and a stomping snare, with a hoarse shouted lead and drunken gang-vocal chorus. Fast, ragged and joyous, getting faster toward the end.
folk/folk-punk-vocal.name: Folk punk
folk/folk-punk-vocal.lyrics: About broke friends, cheap nights and refusing to grow up.

european/schlager-vocal.description: Bright, cheerful German Schlager: bouncing four-on-the-floor beat, sparkling synth hooks, warm brass accents, simple major-key melody and a huge singalong chorus with layered backing vocals and a final key change. Polished, light-hearted and radio-friendly.
european/schlager-vocal.name: Schlager
european/schlager-vocal.lyrics: About love, sunshine and good times, very simple and repetitive.

european/viennese-waltz-instrumental.description: Elegant Viennese waltz for salon orchestra: soaring string melody, lilting anticipated second beat, harp glissandi, woodwind countermelodies and a graceful accelerando into the final section. Romantic 19th-century ballroom atmosphere, natural hall reverb.
european/viennese-waltz-instrumental.name: Viennese waltz (instrumental)

folk/nordic-folk-vocal.description: Haunting, minimal Nordic folk: intimate vocal, acoustic guitar, bowed strings, wooden flute and subtle frame drum, with occasional wordless calling. Cold mystical landscape atmosphere, ancient-sounding modal melodies and very restrained production with lots of space.
folk/nordic-folk-vocal.name: Nordic folk
folk/nordic-folk-vocal.lyrics: About waiting for someone who never returned from a journey through the northern wilderness.

folk/melancholic-folk-ballad-vocal.description: Warm, intimate folk ballad: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft piano, cello and minimal brushed percussion, with a vulnerable close-mic vocal. Simple poetic language, memorable restrained chorus, bittersweet rather than tragic.
folk/melancholic-folk-ballad-vocal.name: Melancholic folk ballad
folk/melancholic-folk-ballad-vocal.lyrics: About finding an old letter from a past relationship and realizing the memories remain even though both lives have moved on.

folk/mystical-medieval-folk-vocal.description: Ethereal medieval folk: Celtic harp, lute, wooden flute, bowed vielle strings and gentle hand percussion. Ancient modal melodies with drone harmony, haunting recurring motifs and open fifths.
folk/mystical-medieval-folk-vocal.name: Mystical medieval folk
folk/mystical-medieval-folk-vocal.lyrics: About an impossible love remembered across centuries, using poetic imagery of old ruins, moonlight, rivers and forgotten names.

folk/sea-shanty-vocal.description: Rousing sea shanty: unaccompanied gang vocals in rough unison and harmony, with foot stomps, hand claps and a single concertina or fiddle joining later. Strict call-and-response between a lead voice and the crew, work-rhythm pulse, growing louder with each verse.
folk/sea-shanty-vocal.name: Sea shanty
folk/sea-shanty-vocal.lyrics: About the sea, hard labour and going home.

folk/romantic-solo-guitar.description: Warm, intimate fingerstyle acoustic guitar with a beautiful recurring melodic theme. Gentle classical influences, subtle harmonic complexity, expressive dynamics and natural string noise. Occasional soft cello and strings add depth without dominating the guitar. Tender, nostalgic and bittersweet. Spacious natural close recording.
folk/romantic-solo-guitar.name: Romantic solo guitar (instrumental)

funk/nu-disco-funk.description: Extremely groovy and joyful nu-disco funk: infectious slap-and-mute bassline, tight sixteenth-note funk guitar, rhythmic Rhodes and clavinet, punchy drums with open hi-hats, catchy synth riffs and string stabs. Highly recognizable hooks, playful interplay between instruments, filtered breakdown and a full-band final chorus. Polished, wide and irresistible.
funk/nu-disco-funk.name: Nu disco funk (instrumental)

funk/classic-funk-instrumental.description: Hard 1970s P-Funk: syncopated slap bass locked to a heavy one-drop kick and snare, wah-wah guitar sixteenths, clavinet stabs, greasy Hammond organ and a punchy horn section trading riffs. One repeating groove with breakdowns, vamps and a screaming sax solo. Raw analog live-band sound.
funk/classic-funk-instrumental.name: Classic funk (instrumental)

gospel/german-worship-vocal.description: German-language modern worship song: warm piano, atmospheric electric guitar with delay, pads and subtle drums that build to the full band, and an honest, unpretentious lead voice with a congregation choir. Simple, very singable melody, calm bridge, big final chorus.
gospel/german-worship-vocal.name: German worship
gospel/german-worship-vocal.lyrics: About trust, gratitude and hope, in simple, modern language.

hiphop/old-school-hiphop-vocal.description: Old-school 1980s hip-hop: crisp electro drum machine, funky bassline, party-record horn stabs, scratching and simple synth hits. Playful call-and-response crowd chants and a straightforward rhyming flow on the beat. Bright, energetic block-party feel, vintage production.
hiphop/old-school-hiphop-vocal.name: Old school hiphop
hiphop/old-school-hiphop-vocal.lyrics: About the neighbourhood, the DJ and having a good time.

gospel/gospel-choir-vocal.description: Uplifting traditional gospel: powerful lead vocal answered by a full gospel choir, gospel piano with big chord runs, Hammond organ swells, walking bass, driving drums and tambourine. Call-and-response, hand claps, a modulation before the final chorus and an ecstatic vamp ending.
gospel/gospel-choir-vocal.name: Gospel choir

gospel/contemporary-worship-vocal.description: Contemporary worship song: atmospheric delay-drenched electric guitar, warm piano, pads, soft programmed and live drums building to a full band, and a sincere lead vocal with congregational backing voices. Simple singable melody, a quiet vulnerable bridge and a big anthemic final chorus.
gospel/contemporary-worship-vocal.name: Contemporary worship
gospel/contemporary-worship-vocal.lyrics: About trust, surrender and hope, in plain modern language.

hiphop/boom-bap-hiphop-vocal.description: Classic 1990s boom-bap: dusty hard-hitting drum break, chopped soul sample loop, warm vinyl crackle, deep upright bass and scratched hook. Laid-back but forceful flow, four-bar loop with subtle variations, gritty SP-1200 style sampling.
hiphop/boom-bap-hiphop-vocal.name: Boom bap hiphop
hiphop/boom-bap-hiphop-vocal.lyrics: About street life, ambition and staying true to yourself.

hiphop/phonk-instrumental.description: Aggressive drift phonk: distorted cowbell melody, heavily saturated 808s, Memphis-style chopped synth sample, lo-fi tape hiss and hard-hitting drums. Dark, hypnotic and relentless, with a distorted drop and a crushed, loud master.
hiphop/phonk-instrumental.name: Phonk (instrumental)

hiphop/german-rap-vocal.description: Modern German rap: hard 808 bass, driving hi-hats, a dark piano or string motif and a short sung hook. Precise, confident flow, clear verse-hook structure, punchy modern mix.
hiphop/german-rap-vocal.name: German rap
hiphop/german-rap-vocal.lyrics: About roots, ambition and the way up, direct and vivid.

hiphop/melodic-trap-vocal.description: Melodic trap: booming 808 bass, crisp rolling hi-hats, snappy snares, a melancholic piano or bell melody and dark pads. Half-time feel, melodic auto-tuned rap verses and a catchy sung hook, with a short beat switch before the last hook.
hiphop/melodic-trap-vocal.name: Melodic trap
hiphop/melodic-trap-vocal.voice: male vocal, melodic rap with autotune
hiphop/melodic-trap-vocal.lyrics: About the rise from nothing, late nights, loyalty and the people who doubted.

hiphop/cloud-rap-vocal.description: Hazy cloud rap: washed-out reverb-soaked synth pads, slow 808s, lazy hi-hats and pitched vocal samples floating in the background. Melodic, half-sung auto-tuned delivery, repetitive hypnotic hook, dreamy and detached.
hiphop/cloud-rap-vocal.name: Cloud rap
hiphop/cloud-rap-vocal.lyrics: About drifting, money, loneliness and late nights.

hiphop/drill-instrumental.description: UK drill: sliding distorted 808 patterns, skittering hi-hat triplets, thin dark piano or string motif and heavy reverb-drenched space. Menacing, minimal and rhythmically off-kilter, with sudden drum drop-outs and a cold, cinematic atmosphere.
hiphop/drill-instrumental.name: Drill (instrumental)

gospel/hymn-choir-vocal.description: Traditional church hymn: pipe organ and mixed four-part choir, stately harmonization, clear phrase-by-phrase structure with a short organ interlude between verses, and a full-organ final verse with a descant. Reverent, majestic, recorded in a large church.
gospel/hymn-choir-vocal.name: Hymn choir
gospel/hymn-choir-vocal.lyrics: Verses of praise and trust - a prayer for strength and peace, the last verse the most joyful.

hiphop/rnb-vocal.description: Smooth, sensual modern R&B: warm Rhodes chords, deep sub bass, soft trap-flavoured drums, finger snaps and silky stacked vocal harmonies with ad-libs. Sultry melodic phrasing, intimate mix, a hushed bridge before the last chorus.
hiphop/rnb-vocal.name: Rnb
hiphop/rnb-vocal.lyrics: About falling in love, trust and vulnerability.

house/acid-house-instrumental.description: Raw 1988 acid house: squelching TB-303 bassline with constant filter and resonance tweaking, TR-909 drum machine, thin stabs and hypnotic minimal arrangement. Repetitive, psychedelic and physical, with the 303 slowly evolving over the whole track. Dry vintage sound.
house/acid-house-instrumental.name: Acid house (instrumental)

hiphop/trap-instrumental.description: Dark atmospheric trap: rolling triplet hi-hats, booming distorted 808 bass with glides, sharp snares and claps on the third beat, eerie plucked or bell synth melody and cinematic pads. Brooding energy, spacious mix, hypnotic four-bar repetition with drop-outs.
hiphop/trap-instrumental.name: Trap (instrumental)

house/bass-house-instrumental.description: Aggressive, groovy bass house: massive distorted bass riffs, hard punchy drums, sharp rhythmic synth hits and catchy recurring motifs. Strong drops, tight build-ups and relentless club momentum without becoming chaotic. Wide stereo production and a loud, punchy master.
house/bass-house-instrumental.name: Bass house (instrumental)

house/deep-house.description: Warm, sophisticated deep house: deep rolling bassline, crisp understated drums with soft open hi-hats, soulful electric piano chords and a simple but highly recognizable melodic motif. Hypnotic repetition with subtle evolution, filtered breakdown, elegant late-night atmosphere.
house/deep-house.name: Deep house (instrumental)

house/afro-house-vocal.description: Deep, warm Afro House: rolling melodic bass, layered organic percussion and congas, tribal shakers, atmospheric synth pads and a soulful vocal hook with chant-like answers. Hypnotic, elegant and highly danceable, with a long percussive breakdown.
house/afro-house-vocal.name: Afro house
house/afro-house-vocal.lyrics: Short, repetitive and uplifting, about movement, connection and freedom.

house/disco-house-vocal.description: Joyful disco house: filtered disco string and horn loops, four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats, slinky bassline, piano stabs and a soulful chopped vocal hook. Bright, uplifting and immediately danceable, with a filtered breakdown and a euphoric final chorus.
house/disco-house-vocal.name: Disco house
house/disco-house-vocal.lyrics: A short, joyful hook about dancing together until the sun comes up.

house/french-house-instrumental.description: Filtered French house: chopped and looped disco sample, heavy phaser and filter sweeps, compressed four-on-the-floor drums, funky guitar stabs and a rolling bassline. Hypnotic loop-based structure, big filter-opening moments, warm saturated Daft-Punk-era production.
house/french-house-instrumental.name: French house (instrumental)

house/progressive-house-sparse-vocals.description: Melodic progressive house with an emotional, memorable lead motif, spacious analog-style synths, soft driving bass and a calm but clear development. Only short vocal phrases used as texture and effect, never full verses. Warm, hypnotic and wide.
house/progressive-house-sparse-vocals.name: Progressive house sparse vocals
house/progressive-house-sparse-vocals.lyrics: A few short phrases about letting go and drifting into the night.

house/melodic-house.description: Emotional, warm and deeply atmospheric melodic house: an unforgettable central melody, recurring synth motifs, soft driving bass and a hypnotic groove. Gradual development, spacious breakdown and uplifting but bittersweet peaks. Wide, lush stereo production.
house/melodic-house.name: Melodic house (instrumental)

house/electro-house-instrumental.description: Bold, punchy electro house: huge bass, crunchy detuned synth riffs, tight drums and an instantly memorable main hook. Strong build-ups, energetic drops and a playful but powerful club character. Clear structure, wide stereo image and polished production.
house/electro-house-instrumental.name: Electro house (instrumental)

house/progressive-house-dreamy-bitterswe.description: Atmospheric, dreamy and bittersweet progressive house: gradual progression, evolving arrangement, distinctive recurring signature riffs, melodic motifs and memorable hooks over a groovy rolling bassline. Long breakdown, patient build, emotional but restrained peak. Wide, airy production.
house/progressive-house-dreamy-bitterswe.name: Progressive house dreamy bittersweet (instrumental)

house/organic-house.description: Warm, flowing organic house: gentle electronic groove combined with acoustic guitar, hand percussion, kalimba, melodic bass and subtle world-music textures. Beautiful recurring motifs, natural development and a spacious sunlit atmosphere. Relaxed but clearly danceable.
house/organic-house.name: Organic house (instrumental)

house/progressive-house-melodic-trance.description: Progressive house with melodic trance influences: highly atmospheric and spacious, memorable signature motifs and distinctive recurring synth riffs, rolling bass and crisp drums. Emotional, smooth and modern, with strong progression, evolving layers and a euphoric but tasteful climax.
house/progressive-house-melodic-trance.name: Progressive house melodic trance (instrumental)

jazz/bebop-instrumental.description: Fast bebop quintet: trumpet and alto sax in unison on an intricate angular head, then blistering improvised solos over rapid ii-V changes, comping piano, walking bass and busy brushless drums with snare bombs. Head-solos-head form, live club atmosphere, raw energy and virtuosity.
jazz/bebop-instrumental.name: Bebop (instrumental)

jazz/cool-jazz-instrumental.description: Cool, restrained modal jazz: muted trumpet stating a spare lyrical melody, tenor sax, understated piano voicings, upright bass and brushed drums. Slow harmonic rhythm over one or two modes, plenty of space, soft dynamics and an introspective late-1950s atmosphere.
jazz/cool-jazz-instrumental.name: Cool jazz (instrumental)

jazz/jazz-funk.description: Sophisticated, extremely groovy jazz-funk: Fender Rhodes, funky sixteenth-note guitar, warm tenor saxophone lead, syncopated melodic bass and tight acoustic drums with ghost notes. Catchy recurring riffs, rich extended harmony, tasteful solos and playful interaction between the instruments. Live-band feel with polished 1970s production.
jazz/jazz-funk.name: Jazz funk (instrumental)

house/tech-house-instrumental.description: Punchy, minimal tech house: deep rolling bassline, tight kick, crisp shuffled percussion and short addictive synth stabs. Strong groove, subtle build-ups, hypnotic repetition with small variations. Dry, wide and club-focused production.
house/tech-house-instrumental.name: Tech house (instrumental)

jazz/dixieland-instrumental.description: New Orleans Dixieland: collective improvisation between clarinet, cornet and trombone, with banjo, tuba or slap bass and a snare-driven two-beat. Joyful polyphony, breaks and stop-time choruses, a rousing final ride-out chorus. Raw, jubilant vintage recording.
jazz/dixieland-instrumental.name: Dixieland (instrumental)

jazz/gypsy-jazz-instrumental.description: Gypsy jazz in the Django tradition: virtuosic acoustic lead guitar with fast arpeggios and tremolo, driving 'la pompe' rhythm guitar, upright bass and a lyrical violin trading solos. Minor swing feel, warm 1930s acoustic recording, accelerating excitement toward the end.
jazz/gypsy-jazz-instrumental.name: Gypsy jazz (instrumental)

jazz/smooth-jazz-instrumental.description: Smooth, warm and soulful smooth jazz: warm tenor sax lead, clean electric guitar, Fender Rhodes, melodic fretless bass and soft drums. Rich extended chords, memorable melodic motifs, tasteful improvisation, subtle funk influence, spacious polished production and gradual development.
jazz/smooth-jazz-instrumental.name: Smooth jazz (instrumental)

kids/birthday-song-vocal.description: Joyful birthday party song: bouncy acoustic guitar and piano, handclaps, light drums, a little brass and a sing-along group chorus. Simple major-key melody, a short count-in, a cheering break and a big final chorus. Warm, festive and fun for every age.
kids/birthday-song-vocal.name: Birthday song
kids/birthday-song-vocal.voice: warm, cheerful vocal with a small group joining the chorus
kids/birthday-song-vocal.lyrics: A birthday song for one person - their name, what makes them special and a big wish for the year ahead; a chorus everybody can sing along.

jazz/smooth-jazz-vocal-positive-resoluti.description: Intimate, soulful smooth jazz. Warm Rhodes, piano and clean guitar as lead instruments, upright bass and soft brushed drums. Include substantial sections without vocals where piano and guitar trade melodies. Gentle build from resignation to quiet confidence.
jazz/smooth-jazz-vocal-positive-resoluti.name: Smooth jazz vocal positive resolution
jazz/smooth-jazz-vocal-positive-resoluti.lyrics: Deep and honest, about a difficult situation that finally finds a positive ending.

jazz/smooth-jazz-vocal-late-night.description: Contemporary smooth jazz with warm tenor saxophone, clean electric guitar, Fender Rhodes, upright bass and brushed drums, plus a silky intimate vocal. Relaxed groove, rich extended chords, soulful phrasing, tasteful solo interplay and an elegant late-night atmosphere. Mature, understated and bittersweet rather than dramatic.
jazz/smooth-jazz-vocal-late-night.name: Smooth jazz vocal late night
jazz/smooth-jazz-vocal-late-night.lyrics: About quiet intimacy, longing and a relationship that feels close but uncertain.

jazz/swing-big-band-instrumental.description: Roaring 1940s swing big band: full brass and saxophone sections trading riffs, walking upright bass, comping piano and swinging ride-cymbal drums with big band shout choruses. Head arrangement with trumpet and tenor sax solos, tight shout chorus and a punchy final ensemble hit. Vintage warm recording.
jazz/swing-big-band-instrumental.name: Swing big band (instrumental)

jazz/vocal-jazz-crooner.description: Classic crooner jazz ballad: velvety baritone vocal with relaxed behind-the-beat phrasing, over lush strings, muted trumpet fills, piano, upright bass and brushed drums. Great-American-Songbook form, one chorus without vocals in the middle, warm vintage mono-flavoured recording.
jazz/vocal-jazz-crooner.name: Vocal jazz crooner
jazz/vocal-jazz-crooner.lyrics: About a love remembered across the years.

kids/children-song-vocal.description: Cheerful children's song: simple major-key melody, acoustic guitar, ukulele, xylophone, hand claps and light percussion, sung by a warm friendly voice with a small children's choir joining the chorus. Clear diction. Bright and happy.
kids/children-song-vocal.name: Children song
kids/children-song-vocal.lyrics: Very simple, repetitive words with an easy call-and-response part - nothing scary or complex.

kids/lullaby-vocal.description: Gentle lullaby: soft music box, warm felt piano, subtle strings and a tender humming voice singing a simple rocking melody. Very quiet dynamics, slow tempo, no percussion, comforting and safe.
kids/lullaby-vocal.name: Lullaby
kids/lullaby-vocal.lyrics: Only a few soothing lines about sleep, stars and being watched over.

latin/bachata-vocal.description: Romantic bachata: nylon and requinto guitar arpeggios with the characteristic lead fills, bongó and güira percussion, warm bass and a heartfelt slightly nasal vocal. Four-beat pattern with the hip accent on beat four, intimate verses and a soaring chorus.
latin/bachata-vocal.name: Bachata
latin/bachata-vocal.lyrics: About longing, devotion and a love that hurts and heals.

kids/kids-adventure-song-vocal.description: Energetic kids adventure song: driving acoustic and light electric guitar, marching drums, brass stabs, whistling hook and an enthusiastic lead vocal with a shouting children's chorus. Playful, exciting and easy to sing along, with a rhythmic chant section.
kids/kids-adventure-song-vocal.name: Kids adventure song
kids/kids-adventure-song-vocal.lyrics: About setting off on a journey, being brave and sticking together.

kids/nursery-rhyme-german-vocal.description: Simple German children's song: cheerful major-key melody, acoustic guitar, recorder, glockenspiel, handclaps and light percussion, sung by a friendly voice with a children's choir in the chorus. Clear pronunciation.
kids/nursery-rhyme-german-vocal.name: Nursery rhyme german
kids/nursery-rhyme-german-vocal.lyrics: Very short, repetitive verses to sing along, about animals, the seasons or everyday life.

kids/german-birthday-song-vocal.description: Cheerful German birthday song: bouncy acoustic guitar and piano, handclaps, light drums and a sing-along group chorus. Simple major-key melody, a cheering break with party noises and a big final chorus. Warm, festive and fun for every age.
kids/german-birthday-song-vocal.name: German birthday song
kids/german-birthday-song-vocal.voice: warm, cheerful vocal with a small group joining the chorus
kids/german-birthday-song-vocal.lyrics: A birthday song for one person - their name, what makes them special and good wishes for the new year of their life; an easy chorus to sing along.

latin/bossa-nova-vocal.description: Warm, gentle bossa nova: nylon-string guitar with the classic syncopated comping pattern, soft brushed drums and shaker, subtle piano, muted trumpet or flute fills and a light, airy, almost whispered vocal. Rich jazz harmony, relaxed and unhurried, warm intimate recording.
latin/bossa-nova-vocal.name: Bossa nova
latin/bossa-nova-vocal.lyrics: About quiet romance, the sea and simple beauty.

latin/merengue-instrumental.description: Fast Dominican merengue: driving two-beat tambora and güira groove, jumping bass, bright saxophone riffs in harmony, piano montuno and accordion. Relentless energy, a jaleo section with escalating sax mambos and horn hits. Pure dancefloor joy.
latin/merengue-instrumental.name: Merengue (instrumental)

latin/cumbia-instrumental.description: Hypnotic, warm cumbia: shuffling güira and guacharaca percussion, deep bouncing bass, accordion melodies, bright trumpet lines and tremolo guitar. Laid-back but danceable, dreamy sunlit Latin atmosphere, repeating melodic hook with call-and-response between accordion and horns.
latin/cumbia-instrumental.name: Cumbia (instrumental)

latin/samba-instrumental.description: Joyful Brazilian samba batucada: surdo heartbeat, tamborim and repinique patterns, cuíca accents, agogô bells, bright cavaquinho comping, seven-string guitar and melodic horns. Driving carnival spirit, tight call-and-response breaks and an irresistible sense of forward movement.
latin/samba-instrumental.name: Samba (instrumental)

latin/latin-pop-vocal.description: Modern Latin pop: Spanish guitar, a light reggaeton-influenced groove, warm bass, shimmering synths and percussion. Sensual verses and a bright, catchy chorus made for the dance floor and the radio.
latin/latin-pop-vocal.name: Latin pop
latin/latin-pop-vocal.lyrics: About a summer romance - a glance across the dance floor, a night by the sea, a love that burns fast.

latin/norteno-corrido-vocal.description: Norteño corrido: lead diatonic accordion and bajo sexto, tuba or electric bass and a marching polka-style drum beat. Two voices in close parallel harmony, with accordion answers between lines. Proud, narrative and rustic, live-band recording.
latin/norteno-corrido-vocal.name: Norteno corrido
latin/norteno-corrido-vocal.lyrics: A story told in verses: one person and a decisive event in their life.

latin/reggaeton-vocal.description: Urban, confident reggaeton: classic dembow beat with syncopated snare, deep sub bass, dark synth stabs, pitched vocal chops and a smooth melodic vocal alternating with rhythmic rapping. Club-ready, catchy hook repeated often, modern loud mix.
latin/reggaeton-vocal.name: Reggaeton

latin/son-cubano-vocal.description: Classic son cubano: tres guitar tumbao, upright bass anticipating the beat, bongó and claves, subtle trumpet obbligato and a warm lead voice answered by a coro. Relaxed clave swing, verse section leading into a montuno call-and-response, vintage Havana recording warmth.
latin/son-cubano-vocal.name: Son cubano
latin/son-cubano-vocal.lyrics: About home, a woman and the passing of time.

latin/salsa-vocal.description: Hot, energetic salsa: powerful montuno piano groove, punchy brass section, congas, timbales, bongó and driving tumbao bass. Clave-based swing, a sung verse leading into an extended montuno / coro call-and-response section with brass mambos and a timbale solo.
latin/salsa-vocal.name: Salsa

latin/tango-instrumental.description: Passionate tango: bandoneón and violin leading over staccato piano and a strong double-bass pulse, with sharp marcato accents and dramatic rubato passages. Dark elegant minor melody, sudden dynamic contrasts, sensual phrasing and a decisive final chord.
latin/tango-instrumental.name: Tango (instrumental)

meditation/nature-soundscape-instrumenta.description: Ambient nature soundscape: gentle rain, distant thunder, a flowing stream and soft birdsong layered under very quiet sustained pads and occasional distant piano notes. Almost no musical development, pure atmosphere, wide natural stereo field, deeply relaxing.
meditation/nature-soundscape-instrumenta.name: Nature soundscape (instrumental)

meditation/meditation-healing-instrument.description: Deep meditation music: sustained warm drone, Tibetan bowls, soft bells, gentle Rhodes or harp notes and very slow evolving pads. No beat, no sudden events, extremely slow harmonic movement and long reverb tails. Calming, spacious and safe, designed for breathing and stillness.
meditation/meditation-healing-instrument.name: Meditation healing (instrumental)

meditation/sleep-music-instrumental.description: Sleep music: extremely soft low-frequency pads, distant muted piano, subtle sub-bass warmth and almost inaudible movement. No percussion, no melody that draws attention, very gradual fade-in and fade-out. Dark, warm and enveloping.
meditation/sleep-music-instrumental.name: Sleep music (instrumental)

meditation/focus-study-instrumental.description: Minimal focus music: steady soft pulse, gentle repeating piano or marimba pattern, warm bass note and light airy pads. Consistent dynamics, no surprises, no sharp transients. Designed to stay in the background and support concentration for long periods.
meditation/focus-study-instrumental.name: Focus study (instrumental)

metal/black-metal-instrumental.description: Atmospheric black metal: cold tremolo-picked tremolo guitar walls, relentless blast beats, buried bass and distant icy synth pads. Repetitive hypnotic minor melodies, raw lo-fi production, a long ambient middle section with clean guitar, then a return to the freezing storm.
metal/black-metal-instrumental.name: Black metal (instrumental)

metal/doom-metal-instrumental.description: Slow, massive doom metal: crushing low-tuned downtuned guitars, thick fuzz bass, huge slow drums and a haunting melodic lead guitar. Dark recurring riff motifs, long sustained chords, enormous space between hits, gradual build to a monolithic climax. Mournful and cinematic rather than chaotic.
metal/doom-metal-instrumental.name: Doom metal (instrumental)

metal/grunge-vocal.description: Raw, heavy grunge: dirty distorted guitars with loose bends, thick bass, powerful sloppy drums and a rough expressive vocal moving between mumbled verses and a screamed chorus. Simple but unforgettable riff, extreme quiet-loud dynamics, unpolished early-1990s production.
metal/grunge-vocal.name: Grunge
metal/grunge-vocal.lyrics: About frustration, disillusionment and feeling trapped between anger and apathy.

metal/folk-metal-vocal.description: Folk metal: heavy distorted riffs interlocked with fiddle, tin whistle and accordion playing a joyful folk melody, driving drums and a rough shouted lead with a huge drunken gang-vocal chorus. Accelerating dance section in the middle, festival energy.
metal/folk-metal-vocal.name: Folk metal
metal/folk-metal-vocal.lyrics: About feasts, journeys and old legends.

metal/death-metal-vocal.description: Brutal death metal: heavily downtuned tremolo-picked riffs, blast beats and rapid double-kick, thick distorted bass and deep guttural growled vocals. Frequent tempo shifts, dissonant harmony, a crushing slow breakdown and a chaotic sweep-picked solo. Dense, dark and uncompromising.
metal/death-metal-vocal.name: Death metal
metal/death-metal-vocal.lyrics: About ancient horror, decay and a darkness that cannot be escaped.

metal/nu-metal-vocal.description: Late-1990s nu metal: seven-string downtuned guitar riffs, heavy syncopated groove, slapped and sliding bass, turntable scratches, subtle samples and drums with a hip-hop swing. Rapped and half-shouted verses, big melodic sung chorus, quiet whispered bridge.
metal/nu-metal-vocal.name: Nu metal
metal/nu-metal-vocal.lyrics: About alienation, anger and not being heard.

metal/industrial-metal-vocal.description: Mechanical, dark industrial metal: crushing detuned guitar riffs locked to rigid programmed drums, deep bass, electronic pulses, samples and cold synthetic textures. Aggressive half-shouted vocals, repetitive hook phrases and a relentless machine-like groove.
metal/industrial-metal-vocal.name: Industrial metal
metal/industrial-metal-vocal.lyrics: About technology, control, identity and humans becoming part of the system.

metal/power-metal-vocal.description: Fast, heroic power metal: twin-guitar harmonies, galloping double-bass drums, symphonic keyboards, driving bass and a soaring clean high vocal. Epic layered chorus, fantasy imagery, neoclassical guitar and keyboard solo trade-off, unstoppable energy.
metal/power-metal-vocal.name: Power metal

metal/sludge-post-metal-instrumental.description: Sludge / post-metal: enormous slow fuzzed-out riffs, feedback, thick bass and thunderous drums, alternating with long clean atmospheric passages of tremolo guitar and reverb. Very gradual crescendo structure, oceanic and crushing, emotional rather than aggressive.
metal/sludge-post-metal-instrumental.name: Sludge post metal (instrumental)

metal/heavy-metal-vocal.description: Powerful, melodic classic heavy metal: galloping palm-muted riffs, harmonized twin-guitar leads, tight bass, hard-hitting drums and a commanding clean vocal with high sustained notes. Strong memorable chorus, energetic transitions and an expressive shredding guitar solo.
metal/heavy-metal-vocal.name: Heavy metal
metal/heavy-metal-vocal.lyrics: About facing fear, standing firm and pushing through darkness.
