metal/symphonic-metal-vocal.description: Dramatic symphonic metal: heavy guitars and double-kick drums combined with full orchestral strings, brass and choir textures, plus a strong operatic-leaning female lead vocal. Memorable melodic themes, huge cinematic chorus, dynamic contrast with a quiet orchestral bridge and a soaring guitar solo.
metal/symphonic-metal-vocal.name: Symphonic metal
metal/symphonic-metal-vocal.lyrics: About fate, loss and finding light within darkness.

metal/metalcore-vocal.description: Modern metalcore: chugging downtuned riffs, melodic lead guitar over screamed verses, a soaring clean-sung chorus, tight double-kick drums and a heavy half-time breakdown at the end. Sharp modern production, strong contrast between aggression and melody.
metal/metalcore-vocal.name: Metalcore
metal/metalcore-vocal.lyrics: About inner struggle, betrayal and fighting back.

metal/melodic-metal-instrumental.description: Powerful, highly melodic metal: heavy rhythm guitars, soaring harmonized lead guitar, tight bass and energetic double-kick drums. Strong recurring themes, dramatic build-ups, a lyrical clean-guitar middle section and a memorable extended solo. Heavy but beautiful, cinematic and uplifting rather than brutal.
metal/melodic-metal-instrumental.name: Melodic metal (instrumental)

musical/german-musical-vocal.description: German-language musical number: dramatic piano intro, a growing orchestra with strings and brass, a driving rhythm section and a big, theatrical chorus with a key change. Clear pronunciation, narrative verses, emotional climax at the end.
musical/german-musical-vocal.name: German musical
musical/german-musical-vocal.lyrics: About a difficult decision and the courage to make it.

pop/bedroom-pop-vocal.description: Lo-fi bedroom pop: slightly detuned chorus guitar, warm tape-saturated synths, soft muffled drums, simple bass and a close, breathy double-tracked vocal. Hazy, intimate and imperfect, with vinyl noise and a woozy pitch drift.
pop/bedroom-pop-vocal.name: Bedroom pop
pop/bedroom-pop-vocal.lyrics: About lying awake, overthinking and small hopes.

pop/art-pop-vocal.description: Adventurous art pop: unconventional song structure, layered vocal harmonies used as instruments, processed drums, orchestral and electronic hybrids, sudden textural shifts and an unexpected harmonic turn in the chorus. Theatrical, detailed and cinematic without losing a memorable hook.
pop/art-pop-vocal.name: Art pop

musical/musical-theatre-ensemble-vocal.description: Big musical theatre ensemble number: pit orchestra with brass, strings, piano and drum kit, a spoken-sung opening verse, a driving patter section, a soaring key-change finale and a full company chorus with counter-melodies. Theatrical, narrative and larger than life.
musical/musical-theatre-ensemble-vocal.name: Musical theatre ensemble
musical/musical-theatre-ensemble-vocal.lyrics: A scene: a crowd, a decision, a turning point.

musical/broadway-ballad-vocal.description: Classic Broadway 'I want' ballad: solo piano intro, gradually adding strings, woodwinds and a full orchestral swell, with a powerful theatrical belt in the final chorus and a held last note. Clear dramatic build, rubato phrasing, one recurring hook line.
musical/broadway-ballad-vocal.name: Broadway ballad
musical/broadway-ballad-vocal.lyrics: About longing for a different life and finally deciding to reach for it.

metal/progressive-djent-instrumental.description: Progressive metal / djent: precise polyrhythmic palm-muted riffs in shifting odd meters, extended-range guitar, ambient clean interludes with lush pads, fretless bass and technical drumming. Long-form structure with a heavy opening, atmospheric middle and a soaring melodic lead climax. Clinical modern production.
metal/progressive-djent-instrumental.name: Progressive djent (instrumental)

metal/thrash-metal-vocal.description: Fast, aggressive thrash metal: razor-sharp palm-muted riffs, relentless double-kick and fast snare, energetic bass and an intense shouted vocal. Abrupt tempo changes, a half-time breakdown, wild whammy-bar solo and a precise machine-gun rhythm section. Raw and rhythmically precise.
metal/thrash-metal-vocal.name: Thrash metal
metal/thrash-metal-vocal.lyrics: About chaos, corruption and loss of control.

pop/dream-pop-electronic-vocal.description: Dreamy electronic pop: warm intimate vocal, shimmering reverb-heavy guitars, soft analog synths, deep melodic bass and restrained electronic drums. Beautiful memorable chorus, bittersweet atmosphere and gradual emotional development with a washed-out bridge. Poetic, simple and understated.
pop/dream-pop-electronic-vocal.name: Dream pop electronic
pop/dream-pop-electronic-vocal.lyrics: About remembering a place and time that can never quite be experienced again.

pop/german-pop-vocal.description: Modern German pop: a clear piano or guitar motif, warm synth pads, programmed and live drums, a driving bass and a big, very catchy chorus with stacked voices. Clear pronunciation, simple vivid language, a calm bridge before the last chorus.
pop/german-pop-vocal.name: German pop
pop/german-pop-vocal.lyrics: About new beginnings, friendship and the courage to start something new.

pop/hyperpop-vocal.description: Maximalist hyperpop: pitched-up chipmunk vocals, distorted 808 bass, glitchy edits, blown-out saturated drums, sugary supersaw chords and abrupt beat switches. Extremely loud, chaotic and euphoric, with an unexpectedly emotional bridge. Very short repetitive hook.
pop/hyperpop-vocal.name: Hyperpop
pop/hyperpop-vocal.lyrics: About being online, overstimulated and in love.

pop/dance-pop-vocal.description: Modern dance-pop: four-on-the-floor kick, bright plucky synths, deep sidechained bass, claps, a tight pre-chorus build and an explosive chorus combining a sung hook with a post-chorus drop. Glossy radio production, huge and immediate.
pop/dance-pop-vocal.name: Dance pop
pop/dance-pop-vocal.lyrics: Simple, confident and about a night that changes everything.

pop/singer-songwriter-acoustic-vocal.description: Honest acoustic singer-songwriter song: fingerpicked or gently strummed acoustic guitar, subtle piano, upright bass and brushed drums entering late, plus a close, unpolished vocal with audible breath. Conversational verses, one quietly devastating refrain, minimal production and lots of space.
pop/singer-songwriter-acoustic-vocal.name: Singer songwriter acoustic
pop/singer-songwriter-acoustic-vocal.lyrics: Plain-spoken and personal, about a conversation that never happened.

pop/indie-pop-vocal.description: Bright indie pop: jangly clean guitars, bouncing bass, live drums with tambourine, warm analog synth accents and a slightly imperfect, charming lead vocal with layered 'ooh' harmonies. Catchy hook, handclaps, warm and slightly lo-fi production.
pop/indie-pop-vocal.name: Indie pop
pop/indie-pop-vocal.lyrics: About a small everyday moment that feels enormous.

punk/punk-rock-vocal.description: Fast, raw and rebellious punk rock: three-chord power-chord riffs, driving eighth-note bass, hammering drums with a fast snare and an energetic shouted vocal with gang-vocal backups. Short punchy sections, no solos, no-frills live production, short and furious.
punk/punk-rock-vocal.name: Punk rock
punk/punk-rock-vocal.lyrics: About frustration, freedom and fighting back.

punk/pop-punk-vocal.description: Bright pop-punk: fast palm-muted power chords, octave lead riffs, galloping bass, driving drums with a skate-punk beat and a nasal earnest vocal with big 'whoa-oh' gang harmonies. Huge singalong chorus, a half-time bridge, polished but energetic production.
punk/pop-punk-vocal.name: Pop punk
punk/pop-punk-vocal.lyrics: About growing up in a boring town, a summer and a broken heart.

rock/classic-rock-vocal.description: Energetic, timeless classic rock: crunchy electric guitars, driving bass, powerful acoustic drums and a charismatic lead vocal. Memorable opening riff, catchy chorus with harmony vocals, a tasteful guitar solo and a natural live-band feel with warm analog production.
rock/classic-rock-vocal.name: Classic rock
rock/classic-rock-vocal.lyrics: About freedom, taking risks and leaving the past behind.

reggae/dub-instrumental.description: Deep, spacious dub: rumbling bass leading everything, stripped-back one-drop drums, offbeat skank fragments drifting in and out through enormous tape echo and spring reverb, sudden drop-outs and filter sweeps. Meditative, psychedelic mixing-desk performance built on reggae's heartbeat.
reggae/dub-instrumental.name: Dub (instrumental)

reggae/rocksteady-vocal.description: Sweet 1960s rocksteady: relaxed shuffling drums, prominent melodic bassline, offbeat guitar and piano, warm horn lines and a soulful lead vocal with close three-part harmony backing. Slower and more soulful than ska, vintage Jamaican studio warmth.
reggae/rocksteady-vocal.name: Rocksteady
reggae/rocksteady-vocal.lyrics: About love, waiting and better days.

punk/ska-punk-vocal.description: Energetic ska punk: upstroke offbeat guitar skanks in the verses exploding into distorted power chords in the chorus, punchy horn section riffs, walking bass, fast drums and an enthusiastic shouted vocal. Constant tempo and feel switches, playful and hyperactive.
punk/ska-punk-vocal.name: Ska punk
punk/ska-punk-vocal.lyrics: About friends, bad jobs and not caring.

pop/power-ballad-vocal.description: Classic power ballad: gentle piano and clean guitar intro, softly sung verse, strings entering in the second verse, full band and huge distorted guitars in the final chorus, a soaring guitar solo and a key change before the last chorus. Enormous emotional dynamic range.
pop/power-ballad-vocal.name: Power ballad
pop/power-ballad-vocal.lyrics: About holding on to someone across distance and time.

rock/blues-rock-instrumental.description: Raw, soulful blues rock: expressive electric guitar with warm overdriven tube tone, deep bass, Hammond organ pads and relaxed but powerful drums. Memorable riff, emotional bends, dynamic extended solo and strong call-and-response phrasing. Organic live-band feel with gradual development.
rock/blues-rock-instrumental.name: Blues rock (instrumental)

punk/post-punk-vocal.description: Cold post-punk: driving melodic bass leading the song, angular chorus-drenched guitar stabs, motorik drums with heavy toms and a detached, half-spoken baritone vocal. Repetitive hypnotic structure, minor key, cavernous reverb and a stark, gray atmosphere.
punk/post-punk-vocal.name: Post punk
punk/post-punk-vocal.lyrics: Fragmentary, about distance, cities and dread.

reggae/ska-jamaican-instrumental.description: Original Jamaican ska: fast offbeat guitar and piano skanks, walking bass, shuffle drums with rim clicks, and a punchy trombone, trumpet and tenor-sax front line trading solos. Joyful, brisk and irresistibly danceable, warm vintage recording.
reggae/ska-jamaican-instrumental.name: Ska jamaican (instrumental)

rock/garage-rock-vocal.description: Raw garage rock: overdriven fuzzy guitar, simple pounding drums, growling bass and a shouted, distorted vocal recorded hot and close. Two-chord riff, handclaps, tambourine, sloppy energy and a short screaming solo. Deliberately lo-fi, live and loud.
rock/garage-rock-vocal.name: Garage rock
rock/garage-rock-vocal.lyrics: Simple and snarling, about a girl and a bad night.

reggae/dancehall-vocal.description: Energetic modern dancehall: digital riddim, punchy programmed drums, syncopated bass, bright synth stabs and a rapid-fire melodic vocal with plenty of ad-libs. Repetitive catchy hook, direct and bright production with a lot of attitude.
reggae/dancehall-vocal.name: Dancehall

reggae/roots-reggae-vocal.description: Laid-back roots reggae: offbeat guitar and piano skanks, deep rolling melodic bass, warm Hammond organ bubble, steady one-drop drums and a soulful lead vocal with harmony backing. Spacious dub-flavoured mix, long solo section with melodica or horns.
reggae/roots-reggae-vocal.name: Roots reggae
reggae/roots-reggae-vocal.lyrics: About unity, inner strength and holding on through hard times.

rock/hard-rock-vocal.description: Heavy, punchy hard rock: massive guitar riffs, tight bass, hard-hitting drums and a powerful rough vocal. Strong groove, memorable hooks, explosive chorus, a melodic guitar solo and a stomping half-time breakdown. Big, loud and confident.
rock/hard-rock-vocal.name: Hard rock
rock/hard-rock-vocal.lyrics: About resilience, pressure and refusing to give up.

rock/indie-rock-vocal.description: Warm, melodic and slightly melancholic indie rock: jangly interlocking guitars, steady melodic bass, live drums and an earnest, slightly fragile vocal. Memorable hooks, gentle dynamics, a lift in the last chorus, honest and heartfelt production.
rock/indie-rock-vocal.name: Indie rock
rock/indie-rock-vocal.lyrics: About growing up, doubt and finding your way.

rock/pop-rock-vocal.description: Radio-ready pop rock: crunchy electric guitars with a catchy riff, solid live drums, driving bass and a warm piano underneath. Restrained verses, a lift in the pre-chorus and a big, open singalong chorus with harmonies; a short guitar solo before the last chorus.
rock/pop-rock-vocal.name: Pop rock
rock/pop-rock-vocal.lyrics: About not giving up when things fall apart, and the people who carry you through.

rock/rockabilly-vocal.description: 1950s rockabilly: slap upright bass, twangy Gretsch-style guitar with heavy slapback echo, brushed snare shuffle and a hiccupping, echo-drenched vocal. Twelve-bar structure, wild guitar break, handclaps and vintage mono tape production.
rock/rockabilly-vocal.name: Rockabilly
rock/rockabilly-vocal.lyrics: About cars, dancing and a girl who won't call back.

rock/post-rock-instrumental.description: Post-rock crescendo: clean delay-and-reverb guitars building layered arpeggios over a slow hypnotic bass and gradually intensifying drums, joined by strings and tremolo-picked guitar walls in a cathartic climax before falling back to near-silence. Instrumental throughout, no verse-chorus form, one long emotional arc.
rock/post-rock-instrumental.name: Post rock (instrumental)

rock/progressive-rock-instrumental.description: Atmospheric, sophisticated progressive rock: expressive electric guitars, melodic bass, acoustic drums, Hammond organ and Mellotron, with evolving recurring themes. Strong contrast between calm passages and powerful sections, unusual but musical meter changes and memorable motifs. Cinematic, emotional and highly developed multi-part structure.
rock/progressive-rock-instrumental.name: Progressive rock (instrumental)

rock/psychedelic-rock-instrumental.description: 1960s psychedelic rock: fuzz guitar with wah and heavy phasing, swirling Hammond organ, sitar-like drones, backwards tape effects, loose live drums and a long hypnotic modal jam. Wide panning trickery, a slow build into a chaotic peak and a woozy fade. Warm analog tape sound.
rock/psychedelic-rock-instrumental.name: Psychedelic rock (instrumental)

rock/southern-rock-vocal.description: Southern rock: twin harmonized lead guitars, slide guitar, boogie piano, thick bass and swinging drums, with a gritty soulful vocal and a gospel-flavoured backing chorus. Long dual-guitar solo section building to a euphoric finish. Warm, live and organic.
rock/southern-rock-vocal.name: Southern rock
rock/southern-rock-vocal.lyrics: About home, the highway and hard-won pride.

rock/shoegaze-vocal.description: Shoegaze wall of sound: heavily layered fuzz and reverb guitars with pitch-bending tremolo, buried melodic bass, steady live drums and a soft androgynous vocal mixed low inside the noise. Beautiful melody hidden under distortion, hazy dreamlike production.
rock/shoegaze-vocal.name: Shoegaze

seasonal/christmas-carol-vocal.description: Traditional Christmas carol: mixed choir in warm four-part harmony, church organ, sleigh bells, harp and gentle strings. Stately verse structure with a descant on the final verse, reverent and joyful, recorded in a church with generous natural reverb.
seasonal/christmas-carol-vocal.name: Christmas carol
seasonal/christmas-carol-vocal.lyrics: About winter night, light and quiet wonder.

rock/surf-rock-instrumental.description: Classic surf rock: wet reverb-drenched tremolo-picked lead guitar, staccato rhythm guitar, driving bass and energetic drums with tom rolls. Minor-key exotic melody, whammy-bar dives, handclaps and a relentless forward drive. Vintage 1960s recording.
rock/surf-rock-instrumental.name: Surf rock (instrumental)

rock/stoner-rock-instrumental.description: Heavy stoner rock: enormous fuzzed-out downtuned riff repeating hypnotically, thick bass, loose swinging drums and a bluesy wah-drenched lead guitar. Desert groove, huge amp room sound, long jam section and a slow massive outro. Warm, dirty analog production.
rock/stoner-rock-instrumental.name: Stoner rock (instrumental)

seasonal/german-christmas-vocal.description: Calm German Christmas song: warm piano, strings, gentle acoustic guitar, glockenspiel and subtle choir voices in the chorus. Simple, very singable melody, festive and peaceful mood, a clear build from quiet to full.
seasonal/german-christmas-vocal.name: German christmas
seasonal/german-christmas-vocal.lyrics: About candlelight, home and the silence of Christmas Eve.

soul/neo-soul-vocal.description: Neo-soul: loose behind-the-beat drums with ghost notes, warm round bass, lush Rhodes chords with extended jazz harmony, muted guitar and layered improvised vocal stacks. Relaxed, organic and harmonically rich, with a floating wordless outro.
soul/neo-soul-vocal.name: Neo soul
soul/neo-soul-vocal.lyrics: About self-worth, patience and choosing yourself.

seasonal/wedding-ceremony-instrumental.description: Wedding ceremony piece: solo piano stating a tender theme, joined by string quartet, soft harp and a distant solo violin. Gradual warm build to a radiant climax, then a gentle close. Elegant, hopeful and timeless, natural acoustic recording with no percussion.
seasonal/wedding-ceremony-instrumental.name: Wedding ceremony (instrumental)

seasonal/christmas-pop-vocal.description: Cheerful retro Christmas pop: sleigh bells, brushed shuffle drums, walking bass, jazzy piano, warm horns, glockenspiel and a smooth crooning vocal with a big backing-vocal chorus. Nostalgic 1960s festive production, key change before the last chorus.
seasonal/christmas-pop-vocal.name: Christmas pop
seasonal/christmas-pop-vocal.lyrics: About coming home for the holidays and snow outside the window.

soul/doo-wop-vocal.description: 1950s doo-wop: close four-part vocal harmony with bass-voice 'dip-da-dip' patterns and a soaring falsetto lead, over a simple I-vi-IV-V progression with triplet piano, brushed drums, upright bass and a lonely saxophone solo. Innocent, romantic and nostalgic, vintage reverb-heavy recording.
soul/doo-wop-vocal.name: Doo wop
soul/doo-wop-vocal.lyrics: About a sweetheart, a first dance and a promise made under the streetlight.

world/andean-folk-instrumental.description: Andean folk: breathy quena and zampoña panpipes carrying a pentatonic melody, charango tremolo, nylon guitar, bombo legüero drum and gentle shaker. Wide mountain-air atmosphere, melancholic yet dancing, a slow lament opening into a lively huayno rhythm.
world/andean-folk-instrumental.name: Andean folk (instrumental)

world/arabic-pop-vocal.description: Modern Arabic pop: oud and qanun melodic lines over a driving darbuka and riq rhythm, lush unison strings playing ornamented maqam phrases, synth bass and modern drums. Melismatic passionate vocal, big singable chorus, glossy production.
world/arabic-pop-vocal.name: Arabic pop

soul/motown-soul-vocal.description: Classic 1960s Motown soul: driving tambourine and backbeat drums, melodic walking bass, bright piano and vibraphone, punchy horn stabs, sweeping strings and a joyful lead vocal answered by a tight female backing trio. Simple irresistible hook, warm vintage mono-flavoured mix.
soul/motown-soul-vocal.name: Motown soul
soul/motown-soul-vocal.lyrics: About falling in love and not being able to hide it.

soul/soul-ballad-vocal.description: Deep southern soul ballad: slow triplet feel, warm Hammond organ, gospel piano, clean guitar, restrained horns and a raw, aching lead vocal that grows into a full-throated cry. Simple chord changes, huge emotional dynamics, vintage Memphis recording.
soul/soul-ballad-vocal.name: Soul ballad

seasonal/wedding-first-dance-vocal.description: Tender wedding ballad for a first dance: soft piano and fingerpicked guitar, a gentle string section swelling in the chorus, light brushed drums. A gentle sway, an intimate first verse and a warm, full final chorus.
seasonal/wedding-first-dance-vocal.name: Wedding first dance
seasonal/wedding-first-dance-vocal.lyrics: A promise to one person for a lifetime: how they met, small moments that matter and the vow to stay.

world/calypso-soca-vocal.description: Bright Caribbean soca: fast driving drum-machine-and-live percussion groove, iron and cowbell, syncopated bass, staccato horn riffs, bright synth stabs and an exuberant lead vocal with crowd chants. Carnival energy, simple repeated hook, huge and joyful.
world/calypso-soca-vocal.name: Calypso soca
world/calypso-soca-vocal.lyrics: About carnival, dancing and letting go.

world/gnawa-instrumental.description: Moroccan Gnawa trance: deep booming guembri bass lute repeating a hypnotic riff, metallic qraqeb castanets driving a relentless shuffle, and call-and-response wordless group chanting. Very gradual acceleration, hypnotic repetition, ceremonial and entrancing.
world/gnawa-instrumental.name: Gnawa
world/gnawa-instrumental.lyrics: No words: call-and-response chanted syllables in a trance.

world/bhangra-instrumental.description: High-energy Bhangra: booming dhol double-headed drum pattern, tumbi twang riff, algoza flute, hand claps, deep modern bass and bright synth stabs. Relentless celebratory groove, call-and-response shouts used rhythmically, joyous and irresistibly danceable.
world/bhangra-instrumental.name: Bhangra (instrumental)

world/gamelan-instrumental.description: Balinese gamelan: interlocking kotekan patterns on bronze metallophones and gangsa, resonant gongs marking the cycle, kendang drum leading sudden tempo and dynamic changes, shimmering detuned tuning. Cyclical structure, explosive unison accents, hypnotic and ceremonial.
world/gamelan-instrumental.name: Gamelan (instrumental)

world/hawaiian-slack-key-instrumental.description: Hawaiian slack-key guitar: warm open-tuned acoustic guitar fingerpicking a gentle melody with hammer-ons and harmonics, soft steel guitar swells, ukulele and light shaker. Relaxed, sunlit and nostalgic, with ocean-breeze calm and a natural close recording.
world/hawaiian-slack-key-instrumental.name: Hawaiian slack key (instrumental)

world/mariachi-vocal.description: Traditional mariachi: trumpet duet in bright harmony, violin section, vihuela and guitarrón, with a powerful passionate vocal using long held notes and grito shouts. Alternating free-rubato opening and a lilting ranchera waltz feel, festive and proudly emotional.
world/mariachi-vocal.name: Mariachi

world/mongolian-throat-singing-instrumen.description: Mongolian steppe music: deep khoomei overtone throat singing over morin khuur horsehead fiddle, tovshuur lute and a slow galloping frame-drum pulse. Wide, windswept open-plain atmosphere, pentatonic melodies, ancient and hypnotic, with long sustained drones.
world/mongolian-throat-singing-instrumen.name: Mongolian throat singing
world/mongolian-throat-singing-instrumen.lyrics: No words: overtone throat singing on held vowels.

world/qawwali-vocal.description: Devotional Qawwali: harmonium and tabla groove with insistent group handclaps, a lead voice improvising ecstatic melismatic phrases answered by a male chorus. Starts slow and meditative, then accelerates through repeated refrains into a trance-like ecstatic climax. Live gathering feel.
world/qawwali-vocal.name: Qawwali
world/qawwali-vocal.lyrics: Devotional praise of the divine beloved, a refrain repeated with growing ecstasy.

world/turkish-folk-instrumental.description: Anatolian Turkish folk: bağlama / saz lead with fast tremolo and microtonal ornaments, ney flute, kemençe, darbuka and davul percussion in an asymmetric rhythm. Modal makam melody, a free-rhythm improvised opening, then a driving dance section.
world/turkish-folk-instrumental.name: Turkish folk (instrumental)
